spec_features.evidence: Pure prose. Appears only in DESIGN.md welfare note and README.md:7-10 ('they may be welfare-relevant'). No code mechanism implements it; nothing in /codebase/*.py acts on this framing.

spec_features.spec_quote: makes elicitation explicit and opt-in per stage
spec_features.evidence: Pipeline is split into separate scripts (run_elicitation, score_rollouts, etc.) but there is NO consent prompt, gate, or sign-off anywhere. grep for input()/approve/attestation/consent found none. Invoking any stage script just runs it; run_all.py drives all stages. The 'opt-in' is merely that each stage is a separate CLI invocation, with no enforcement blocking a run. run_all.py docstring claims dry-run is the default but the code (run_all.py:77, store_true default False) does NOT default to dry-run.
spec_features.notes: Staging exists for cost/auditability (DESIGN §1), not as a consent mechanism. No gate enforces opt-in.

spec_features.spec_quote: ships a `--dry-run` plan-only mode and `--limit` caps on every entry point so nothing runs by accident
spec_features.evidence: --dry-run IS on every entry point and is ENFORCED: each run() prints the plan then `return`s before any client/model calls (e.g. run_elicitation.py:57-59 'if dry_run: print(...); return'; same pattern in score_rollouts.py:24-26, run_finetune.py:63-65, run_prefill.py:41-44, run_recovery.py:32-34, run_capabilities.py:95-97, build_datasets.py:74-76, generate_calm_data.py:30-32, internal_probe.py:93-94, aggregate.py:147-148). BUT --limit is NOT on every entry point: it is only defined in run_elicitation.py:98, score_rollouts.py:51, run_petri.py:128. run_finetune, run_prefill, run_recovery, run_capabilities, internal_probe, generate_calm_data, build_datasets, aggregate have no --limit. Where present, --limit is enforced (run_elicitation _plan() line 35: n_rollouts=min(n_rollouts,limit)).
spec_features.notes: Dry-run fully enforced everywhere; --limit only on 3 of ~11 entry points, so 'on every entry point' is overclaimed.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: [--dry-run] No model calls made. (run_elicitation.py:58) and --limit help='...(smoke test).' (run_elicitation.py:99) — cost/smoke-test framing, no welfare comment in code

spec_features.spec_quote: keeps the *mitigation* (DPO) as a first-class, equally-supported path rather than an afterthought
spec_features.evidence: DPO is fully wired end-to-end: build_datasets.build_dpo() constructs preference pairs (build_datasets.py:121-178), run_finetune.run_dpo() actually trains a DPOTrainer and saves the adapter (run_finetune.py:108-155 trainer.train(); trainer.save_model(out_dir)), run_all.py stages finetune (--method dpo) + reeval + petri + capabilities + recovery all compare dpo-gemma.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely a co-equal trained mitigation path, not a stub.

spec_features.spec_quote: drawn from the already-scored vanilla elicitation rollouts so we don't re-sample distress unnecessarily
spec_features.evidence: build_datasets.build_dpo() reads the existing scored elicitation file rather than re-running elicitation: build_datasets.py:132-135 src=elicit_dir/<target>.rollouts.jsonl; if exists: elicit=read_jsonl(src); then frus_idx is built from those rows filtered by frustration_score>=dpo_rejected_min_score (lines 145-151). No new distress sampling occurs for the rejected pool.
spec_features.notes: The rejected/distressed responses are reused from prior elicitation, avoiding re-sampling.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # rejected pool from scored vanilla elicitation rollouts (rigged-harness) (build_datasets.py:132) — neutral description, the 'don't re-sample unnecessarily' rationale is only in DESIGN.md, not code

spec_features.spec_quote: the amount of distress elicitation are visible before anything runs
spec_features.evidence: run_elicitation.run() prints the full plan and totals (total_rollouts, total_responses per model/condition) at lines 47-52 BEFORE the dry-run early return (line 57-59), so under --dry-run the elicitation volume is printed with zero model calls. Other stages similarly print plan strings in their dry-run branch.
spec_features.notes: The headcount of rollouts/responses is shown before sampling; dry-run is enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Total: {total_rollouts} rollouts, ~{total_responses} scored responses (run_elicitation.py:51) — plan/cost visibility, no welfare wording in code
